decisions.reason: The source adds selection between ETH and USDC for wallet payment; it does not change the separate Transak fiat-card flow.
Choosing between ETH and USDC for wallet payment does not change seedless wallet provisioning for fiat buyers.
USDC remains a supported wallet-mint path; adding a selector and an ETH alternative does not change the USDC mint-flow state.
The wallet payment-method selector does not alter the mint price or allocation among founder, affiliate, and prize pool.
ETH support was already established by message 327; message 328 adds the separate method-selection behavior without changing the ETH mint flow itself.
Allowing users to select ETH or USDC does not change the rule that only successful mint transactions are recorded.
The source concerns selection of the wallet asset used for minting and does not specify any change to tip presets, custom tips, or tip payment handling.
The no-referral commission amount and recipient-selection rule remain unchanged regardless of whether ETH or USDC is selected for payment.
The source requires an in-flow ETH/USDC selector but does not require a corresponding FAQ revision or invalidate any current FAQ attribute.
Wallet payment-method selection does not affect Chainlink VRF winner selection, eligibility, weighting, or verification.
The source does not request changes to the About page, and its existing project, process, and technology copy remains valid.
Selecting ETH or USDC for a mint does not change automatic prize transfer or winner announcement behavior.
